datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data across Zambia on a monthly basis throughout 2015 (January, April, July, October). The data represents near-term projections of acute food insecurity phases classified according to the IPC scale, with spatial boundaries delineated as geographic features (GeoJSON/KML) at the sub-national administrative level.
